archetypes.name: dyn-review-topology
archetypes.rationale: Static panel shrank from four specialists to three and topology authority comments changed.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect config.py _CODE_REVIEW_ARCHETYPES, STATIC_REVIEWERS, topology.tsv, and review dispatch/count tests for any remaining architectural-compliance or four-specialist assumptions. Confirm plan-review waterfall always passes --model-role review with tier-resolved --default-model for MODERATE and HARD. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
